ruling.recommended_action: Reject the fare-difference claim; no refund due. Note driver's route-change request complied with the "agree before you go" requirement (chat timestamp 23:03 precedes the 23:06 off-route segment). No account flag needed.

segment_findings.reason: RD-5: driver proposed the Bedok South Avenue 3 route change before leaving the optimal route (chat F7 at 23:03) and the rider explicitly agreed (F8 at 23:03), earlier than the segment start 23:06. The consent names the specific alternative, so this off-route segment is not a route deviation; RD-2 refund not triggered.

rejected_claims.reason: Excess-distance charge is not refundable: the sole off-route segment (F3) is exempt under RD-5 (pre-departure rider consent, F7/F8 at 23:03 vs segment start 23:06), so there is no unexempted detour segment to refund under RD-2.

Total charged $53.17 comprises only base, metered distance, metered time and the published $1.47 platform fee — no unpublished or non-qualifying add-on, so FARE-1/FARE-2 give no basis to reduce it; waiting fee is $0.00.
